_note: Framework defaults. Everything here can be overridden by a case.json or a study file. Keys beginning with an underscore are comments and are ignored.

ic._mode: flat | flat_neg | rest. 'flat' is what every existing sweep used.

windows._note: Sliding-window signature used for mid-run transition detection.

classify._amp_tol_wh: below this peak-to-peak/2h a window counts as static
classify._peak_power_frac: above this fraction of power in the peak band a window is a clean tone (LCO), below it is broadband
classify._stationarity_tol: relative amplitude drift between the first and second half that marks a record as not yet settled

store._save_history_if: which points keep their FULL centre history: transition | nonstationary | near_threshold | divergent | all | none

duration_policy._note: How a flagged point gets promoted to a longer run by qs_refine_points.
